description: Live job openings for a role, near a place or remote, from job boards (LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, national boards) and remote-job sites, newest relevant first, with links to apply on the employer's page. Works without a key. Pass the role as people say it ("electrician", "nurse", "data analyst") and the place as "City, Country".

location.description: "City, Country" or a country; leave out for anywhere

role.description: The job title or kind of work

name: search_jobs

jobs.description: Openings: job_id, title, company, location, work_type, pay, posted, url, source, match

more_pending.description: True while more boards are still being searched; the same search shortly after adds them

title: Search jobs
